faq.heading: Questions before choosing?
faq.subtitle: Answers about payment, availability, documents, and visits.
faq.a1: Yes, we work with several banks that offer mortgage loans with favorable terms. Our managers will help you choose the best option.
faq.a2: Apartments are delivered with finished repairs but without furniture. We can recommend interior design partners if needed.
faq.q3: Is it possible to extend the payment period?
faq.a3: Yes, we offer flexible payment plans. You can discuss installment options with our sales team.
faq.q4: Where is your sales office located?
